date.as_written: abde lakṣmaṇabhūpate ṛtusaridyo(gīmahe)śānanair bbhavye bhāskaravāsare sugaṇite māghe dvitīyāśite

notes: The manuscript was copied in the village of Surahikā in Mithilā. The colophon breaks off at the end (sāgaralaṃgha(na)///), where the scribe's name was likely recorded. The chronogram for the Lakṣmaṇasena era (LS) year is difficult to reconstruct with certainty due to damaged akṣaras.
